answers.core: i dont think it can be implemented as an addon as i believe it requires changing engine source code?
answers.workaround: it can almost be worked around at the moment, by manually setting a sprites z index. however, as z index is an integer type, this loses precision and leads to flickering. additionally, it would be nice to be able to use the z index on top of a custom sort direction.
